接口 Transparency

  • 所有已知子接口:
    Paint
    所有已知实现类:
    AccelTypedVolatileImage, BufferedImage, BufImgSurfaceData, Color, ColorModel, ColorUIResource, ComponentColorModel, D3DSurfaceData, D3DSurfaceData.D3DWindowSurfaceData, DirectColorModel, GDIWindowSurfaceData, GradientPaint, IndexColorModel, LinearGradientPaint, MultipleGradientPaint, NullSurfaceData, OffScreenImage, OGLSurfaceData, PackedColorModel, PrintColorUIResource, RadialGradientPaint, SunVolatileImage, SurfaceData, SystemColor, TexturePaint, VolatileImage, WGLSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLOffScreenSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLVSyncOffScreenSurfaceData, WGLSurfaceData.WGLWindowSurfaceData, Win32ColorModel24

    public interface Transparency
    The Transparency interface defines the common transparency modes for implementing classes.

    • 字段概要

      字段 
      限定符和类型 字段和说明
      static int BITMASK
      Represents image data that is guaranteed to be either completely opaque, with an alpha value of 1.0, or completely transparent, with an alpha value of 0.0.
      static int OPAQUE
      Represents image data that is guaranteed to be completely opaque, meaning that all pixels have an alpha value of 1.0.
      static int TRANSLUCENT
      Represents image data that contains or might contain arbitrary alpha values between and including 0.0 and 1.0.
